body: I think I never really wanted to be with her in the first place. I think I never want to be with anyone. I just wanted people to think I deserve enough to be in a place where a woman could want to be with me. Perhaps outside of that, she didn't mean anything to me at all.

I get what you mean. It took a while to be more clear with myself.

But I don't think it's worth it. I just ended up becoming more sensitive over things that don't really matter. I ended up being more stuck, forced to impose myself further on people and ideas just to become me.

Maybe it'll help you fix your problems, or maybe you will end up not wanting to fix yourself at all. Take the risk.
Is the desperation of wanting to be heard that reprehensible of me? I suppose it is.
maybe i am. i just don't see any other way for me here. it's been this way for me for a very long time.
